{{Quote|We are pleased to announce the arrival of a distinguished ambassador from the planet Aaldus 6, newly entered into the Empire. The ambassador brings trade and goodwill to us from his wealthy star system, and we are making preparations to welcome him.|An announcement from the [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Imperial Diplomatic Corps]]|<ref name="SWG:HSPitG" />}}
'''Aaldus 6''' was a wealthy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:HSPitG" />
{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Aaldus 6 was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HSPitG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
